title: Mini-Project: Build a Full-Stack GSD Command
objective: Extend your Module 1 skeptic command with the Node.js backend — completing all 4 layers of a GSD command

content.value:
In Module 1, you built the markdown layer of /gsd:skeptic -- a command spec and workflow file. But those files are just the prompt side. To make a command that GSD can actually dispatch, you need the Node.js backend: a handler function and a switch case in the router. That is what you will build now.

You will be creating files in your live GSD installation at ~/.claude/get-shit-done/. This means your skeptic command will actually work as /gsd:skeptic when you are done.

You already know the command lifecycle from lessons 1-5. Now you will close the loop by wiring your skeptic command into the actual GSD codebase.

If you get stuck, use the hint command. Hints start vague and get more specific, but they never give you the code -- that part is yours.
content.bridge: Before you start coding, here is how to check your progress.

content.value:
When you are ready to check your work, run the verify command. When you want a nudge, run the hint command. You can run both as many times as you like.

Tip: if something goes wrong, remember that `git checkout` can undo changes in your live GSD installation at ~/.claude/get-shit-done/. You are working on the real codebase, but everything is recoverable.
content.bridge: Here are the exact requirements for the command you will build.

content.task: Extend your /gsd:skeptic command with a Node.js handler and switch case, completing all 4 layers of the GSD command lifecycle.
deliverables: A command spec at ~/.claude/commands/gsd/skeptic.md (already built in Module 1 -- verify it is still there)
A workflow file at ~/.claude/get-shit-done/workflows/skeptic.md (already built in Module 1 -- verify it is still there)
A handler function at ~/.claude/get-shit-done/bin/lib/skeptic.cjs following the cmd* naming convention
A new 'skeptic' case in ~/.claude/get-shit-done/bin/gsd-tools.cjs switch statement that routes to your handler
content.bridge: Complete all four deliverables and run verify to confirm your full-stack command mastery.

successCriteria:
Running --verify shows all checks passing: command spec exists, workflow exists, handler file exports a cmd* function, switch case routes to handler, output follows GSD pattern. All 4 layers verified.

Want to go deeper? Press [c] to copy this lesson to your clipboard and paste it into your favorite LLM for follow-up questions.
